articles.title: Home Alone sequel reportedly in development with Macaulay Culkin returning
articles.summary: Christmas comedy hit is set for a follow-up from the point of view of the father with Seth Rogen as writer and producer A Home Alone sequel is reportedly in development with original star Macaulay Culkin set to return. According to Puck’s Matthew Belloni , Culkin met with Disney executives earlier this year with a pitch for a follow-up and now the project has been met with a green light. The new Home Alone film will bring the 46-year-old back to the franchise as Kevin McCallister for a comedy that, according to Deadline , will be from the father’s point of view. Continue reading...

articles.title: Melania: the series review – so bad it robbed me of my capacity to discern time and space
articles.summary: The first lady’s two-part TV documentary is a dead-eyed advert that barely manages to masquerade as entertainment. Calling it thin gruel would be an insult to the gruel industry Previously on Melania: earlier this year – either because it found her a compelling subject, or because it wanted to flatter the president before a potentially destructive upcoming antitrust trial – Amazon spent $75m (£57m) to make and market a theatrically released documentary about Melania Trump. I’m telling you this for two reasons. First, because you didn’t watch the Melania film. Nobody did, except for journalists who sat in otherwise empty cinemas and (if reports are to believed) people who responded to Craigslist ads offering them $50 to see it. The second reason is because Melania is a series now. Continue reading...

articles.title: Delays mean Robert Pattinson doesn’t have to do a third Batman movie. DC Studios had better persuade him – and fast
articles.summary: The actor’s new role as James Bond could be bad news for DC, as a new owner, new chief and new director already threaten to shake and stir Gotham’s distinctive hero Can one actor play both Batman and James Bond? This is the question many have been asking since Robert Pattinson was announced as the new 007 . The obvious answer is yes: the 40-year-old Englishman has the poise, charisma and steel to join His Majesty’s Secret Service, and saving Gotham could soon become something he fits in between assignments. Among all the furore over Pattinson’s appointment, it would have been easy to miss some rather less cheering news for the citizens of Gotham.
